OverviewPower OptionsSpecifications

Stable 24V power for LED lighting

Featuring a resonant circuit design, this power supply is engineered for stable operation under constant-load conditions. Its efficient power conversion design and thermal management help support reliable performance during extended use.

Available in five rated power options — 60W, 100W, 200W, 300W, and 400W — the series provides flexible selection for different lighting system requirements.

With an AC185–264V input range and DC24V output, the Yilong Series II offers a practical power solution for LED lighting installations requiring a regulated 24V DC supply.

The protective potting treatment is designed to improve resistance to dust, moisture, and insects.
